hindsight.name: NVIDIA

research.preconditions: Profitable (FY23 GAAP diluted EPS $1.74) but in a cyclical down-leg: total revenue flat, Gaming revenue -27% to $9.07B in FY23 (same source). It held the bottleneck position in AI accelerators. The stock bottomed while revenue was flat. Basis: primary (SEC 8-K Ex.99.1). The pipeline should recompute the price multiple.
research.catalysts: Generative-AI demand shock after ChatGPT (Nov 2022) drove hyperscaler H100/data-center GPU orders; NVIDIA was the sole scaled supplier of training GPUs plus CUDA software. Revenue re-accelerated from a flat base starting with the FY2024 quarters.

hindsight.name: Advanced Micro Devices

research.preconditions: Deeply loss-making: FY2015 GAAP operating loss $481M, net loss $660M ($0.84/share); revenue falling 28%. A turnaround or near-distress start, not a bottleneck position. Basis: primary (AMD IR release).
research.catalysts: Zen architecture (Ryzen 2017, EPYC server CPUs) restored competitiveness against Intel during Intel's manufacturing delays. Semi-custom console chips gave a revenue floor. Execution under the CEO quoted in the release (Lisa Su).

hindsight.name: Tesla

research.preconditions: Turned free-cash-flow positive: FY2019 FCF $1.1B, Q4 2019 FCF about $1.0B (same letter). The stock bottomed mid-2019 when the market doubted that cash flow would last. Basis: primary (Tesla IR letter).
research.catalysts: Model 3 volume ramp, Shanghai Gigafactory start-up, a run of GAAP-profitable quarters. Context, not sourced here: S&P 500 inclusion in Dec 2020.

hindsight.name: Super Micro Computer

research.preconditions: Profitable (Q4 FY22 non-GAAP EPS $2.62), revenue growing, low valuation as a hardware assembler. Became a bottleneck integrator once AI demand hit. Basis: primary (SMCI IR).
research.catalysts: First-to-market rack-scale GPU servers and liquid cooling for NVIDIA H100 deployments. FY2023 guidance was $6.2B-$7.0B (same release).

research.preconditions: Margins were compressed by inflation and supply chain in 2022. FCF was negative in H1 2022: the Q3 2022 release guided full-year FCF to a use of $100M-$150M. Pricing actions and backlog preceded the margin recovery. Basis: primary 10-K; backlog-coverage claim is secondary.
research.catalysts: Data-center thermal management (liquid cooling) and power demand from AI densification. A record backlog of $4.8B at year-end 2022 (+49%) covered more than 70% of 2023 sales guidance (Q4 2022 call; secondary). 2023 guidance: net sales $6,450M-$6,600M.

research.preconditions: FY2022 GAAP net loss $(160)M; Adjusted EBITDA (non-GAAP) $2,667M; 2023 Adjusted EBITDA guidance $2.9B-$3.3B (release 2023-02-16). The largest US nuclear fleet, an asset that cannot be replicated quickly. Basis: primary (company release).
research.catalysts: Spun off from Exelon in Feb 2022. Data-center demand for firm carbon-free power. On 2024-09-20 it signed a 20-year PPA with Microsoft to restart TMI Unit 1 as the Crane Clean Energy Center (about 835 MW), its largest-ever PPA (https://sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001868275/000186827524000058/ceg-202409208kexh991.htm). The 10x year needs pipeline price verification.

research.preconditions: FY2021 net loss $(1,264)M, driven by Winter Storm Uri. Ongoing Operations Adjusted EBITDA $1,941M vs $3,766M in 2020 (release 2022-02-25). A one-off loss masked the earnings power. Basis: primary (company IR).
research.catalysts: Recovery from the Winter Storm Uri loss, nuclear fleet expansion (Energy Harbor), buybacks, and the re-rating of dispatchable power for data centers. The 10x year needs pipeline price verification.

research.preconditions: Revenue growth was decelerating (24%). GAAP profit had just turned positive. FY2022 adjusted FCF $203M (11% margin). Stock-based compensation was heavy. Basis: primary (SEC Ex.99.1).
research.catalysts: First GAAP-profitable quarter in Q4 2022 (net income $31M), later sustained, which made it eligible for index inclusion. AIP (enterprise LLM platform) launched in 2023 and US commercial growth accelerated.

research.preconditions: Pre-scale and loss-making: FY2022 net loss $48.5M. Cash and investments $537.8M at 2022-12-31, a long runway relative to the loss. 2023 revenue guidance $18.4M-$18.8M. Basis: primary (IonQ IR).
research.catalysts: Bookings beat guidance, government and enterprise system sales, and the sector-wide quantum re-rating in late 2024.

research.preconditions: Deeply loss-making: FY2023 operating loss $72.3M, net loss $75.1M. Cash and AFS securities $99.9M at 2023-12-31, a short runway at that loss rate before later equity raises. Revenue was shrinking. Basis: primary (Rigetti IR).
research.catalysts: Novera QPU sales (including to AFRL) and the UK NQCC 24-qubit system win. Sector sentiment shock in Dec 2024 drove a speculative re-rating.

research.preconditions: Tiny revenue base, heavy losses, reliance on equity issuance. Bought at a trough below $1 per share (pipeline to verify). Basis: primary (D-Wave IR).
research.catalysts: Annealing-based commercial QCaaS bookings growth and the quantum sector re-rating in late 2024.

research.preconditions: Loss-making, with revenue growth slowed to 16% after the launch anomaly. Raised $355M in convertible notes. Backlog was large relative to revenue. Basis: primary (company release / 10-K).
research.catalysts: Space Systems (satellite buses and components) and defense constellation contracts, the Neutron medium-lift program, and launch cadence recovery after the Sept 2023 anomaly. Backlog was $1,046.1M at 2023-12-31 (10-K).

hindsight.name: Celestica

research.preconditions: Profitable, low-margin EMS business: Q4 2022 non-IFRS operating margin 5.3%. Record non-IFRS margin and EPS in FY2022. Low starting valuation multiple. 2023 guidance at least $7.5B. Basis: primary (company release).
research.catalysts: Hyperscaler networking switches (400G/800G) and custom AI compute (HPS/ODM-like model) mix shift lifted margins and growth.

research.preconditions: Small cap with a GAAP net loss (FY2023 net loss about $16.55M per MarketScreener summary; secondary). A customer-concentration guide-down left revenue temporarily declining at the start. High gross margin (FY23 non-GAAP about 58%). Basis: primary (SEC Ex.99.1) plus secondary for the net loss.
research.catalysts: Active electrical cables (AECs) ramping at new hyperscale customers. FY2024 revenue $192.97M; about 3/4 of Q4 FY24 revenue was AI-driven; management expected an AEC inflection in H2 FY25 (FY24 release, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1807794/000162828024025607/credoq42024ex-991.htm).

hindsight.name: AppLovin

research.preconditions: GAAP net loss of $193M in FY2022, but FCF positive at $388.0M and adjusted EBITDA above $1B (38% margin). A depressed multiple after the post-IPO collapse. Basis: primary (10-K).
research.catalysts: AXON 2.0 machine-learning ad engine (2023) drove a sharp acceleration in software-platform revenue and margins, then the expansion into e-commerce advertising.

research.preconditions: GAAP operating loss $208.9M in FY2023; non-GAAP operating profit $19.2M; non-GAAP gross margin 25.8%; Q4 2023 revenue -22.8% YoY. 2024 guidance $1.4B-$1.6B. Basis: primary (company IR).
research.catalysts: On-site, behind-the-meter fuel-cell power for AI data centers facing grid interconnection delays (utility and hyperscaler/infrastructure-partner agreements in 2024-2025).

hindsight.name: Oklo

research.preconditions: Pre-revenue. FY2024 net cash used in operating activities $38.4M (10-K). Net loss $73.6M and cash plus marketable securities $275.3M at 2024-12-31 (secondary coverage). 2025 operating cash-use guidance $65M-$80M. Basis: primary 10-K for cash use; secondary for net loss and cash.
research.catalysts: Listed via the AltC SPAC merger (closed 2024-05-09). Advanced-reactor (SMR) policy support and data-center power framework agreements. A thematic re-rating of nuclear in 2025.

hindsight.name: Enphase Energy

research.preconditions: Near-distress: Q4 2017 GAAP operating loss $2.1M, non-GAAP operating income $1.3M, cash about $29.1M. Revenue declining. Basis: primary (10-K / Q4 2017 release). Instructive because the stock later round-tripped a large part of the gain (not sourced here).
research.catalysts: Restructuring and cost cuts, IQ microinverter gross-margin expansion, and a return to non-GAAP profitability in Q4 2017. The residential solar plus storage cycle followed.

hindsight.name: Celsius Holdings (non-sector control)

research.preconditions: Small base, accelerating revenue, gross profit +49% to $31.3M. Net income to common $10.0M, including a $12.5M one-off Asia gain. Basis: primary (SEC Ex.99.1).
research.catalysts: US distribution expansion and fitness-energy category share gains; later a PepsiCo distribution deal. Included to show that a tenfold run needs growth acceleration on a small base, not a particular sector.

hindsight.name: Plug Power (cautionary)

research.preconditions: GAAP loss-making with negative gross margin in Q1 2019 ($(6.8)M, per Q1 2019 release). Equity-funded. Basis: primary (SEC 8-K). Cautionary: the 10x was driven by the theme without FCF; the later reversal was not sourced here.
research.catalysts: Hydrogen and green-policy theme (2020), forklift fuel-cell customer wins, and a positive adjusted EBITDA year as described by the company.

hindsight.name: Micron Technology

research.preconditions: Already profitable at a cyclical recovery point: FY2025 operating cash flow $17.53B; Q1 FY26 gross-margin guidance 51.5% ±1.0%. A mega cap that still 10x'd thanks to a memory supercycle. Basis: primary (SEC Ex.99.1, via search extract) plus secondary for HBM and market cap.
research.catalysts: HBM ramp (Q4 FY25 HBM revenue near $2B, secondary) and an AI-driven DRAM/NAND supply shortage. Market cap first topped $1T on 2026-05-26 (Reuters via secondary). The stock later retreated from a late-June 2026 peak above $1,200 (Barchart).

hindsight.name: Sandisk

research.preconditions: GAAP net loss of $1.641B in FY2025, including a $1.83B goodwill impairment. Gross margin recovering (30.1% vs 16.1%). An orphaned spin-off at a cyclical trough. Basis: primary (company release).
research.catalysts: Spun off from Western Digital in Feb 2025. NAND price upcycle driven by AI inference and enterprise SSD demand. Secondary reports describe a gain of several thousand percent from the April 2025 low (e.g., Stacker, May 2026: about $30 to about $1,447).

hindsight.name: Western Digital

research.preconditions: Profitable and FCF positive (Q4 FY25 FCF $675M). A capacity-disciplined duopoly in HDD. Basis: primary (SEC Ex.99.1).
research.catalysts: Pure-play HDD after the Sandisk separation; cloud was 90% of revenue. AI data-lake capacity demand; HDD output reportedly sold out for 2026 (secondary). Deleveraging ($2.6B debt reduction), new dividend, $2.0B buyback.

research.preconditions: Barely GAAP profitable: FY2025 GAAP net income $25.9M; non-GAAP net income $146.4M; non-GAAP operating margin 9.7%. Q4 FY25 Cloud & Networking +66.5% YoY, i.e. revenue was accelerating at the start. Basis: primary (company IR).

hindsight.name: SK hynix

research.preconditions: Profits had just recovered from a 2023 loss year. Bottleneck supplier (lead HBM vendor). The start valuation ignored HBM's structural margin. Basis: Korea Herald report of the company release (reported).
research.catalysts: HBM leadership (HBM sales >4.5x in 2024; HBM >40% of Q4 2024 DRAM revenue), HBM3E/HBM4 supply to NVIDIA, and the 2025-26 memory price surge. Market cap hit ₩1,680T (about $1.12T) on 2026-05-27 (https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/5/29/south-koreas-sk-hynix-enters-exclusive-1-trillion-club).

hindsight.name: EcoPro

research.preconditions: Holding company of EcoPro BM, profitable on record 2022 results. Valuation was stretched: Samsung Securities cited a premium of about 20% over the value of its subsidiary holdings, and Morgan Stanley said EcoPro BM's fair value was about half the price. Earnings halved in 2023 (KED). Basis: reported.
research.catalysts: Retail ('Ants') buying of the cathode-material theme tied to IRA-era battery localization. Up 848% YTD by early July 2023 and passed ₩1M per share. Retail net buying was ₩1.42T from Jan 2 to Apr 19, 2023 (reported).

hindsight.name: HD Hyundai Electric

research.preconditions: Trough profitability: 2021 operating profit ₩9.7B, -87% YoY (Asia Business Daily, 2022-02-04). Near-breakeven, under-owned grid-equipment maker just before the supply shortage. Basis: reported.
research.catalysts: US grid replacement cycle, a transformer shortage and AI/data-center load growth. Pricing power on high-voltage transformers. 2024 operating profit ₩669B, +112.2% YoY (https://www.asiae.co.kr/en/article/2025012011045590430). Q1 2023 margin passed 8% for the first time since the 2017 spin-off.

hindsight.name: Hyosung Heavy Industries

research.preconditions: Profitable but low-margin conglomerate spin-off with leverage. Profit was inflecting (2023 operating profit vs 2022). Bottleneck in US extra-high-voltage transformers. Basis: primary (company IR page).
research.catalysts: US 765kV ultra-high-voltage transformer demand; reportedly supplied nearly half of the 765kV units installed in the US. Memphis plant expansion from 130 to more than 250 units per year. Record backlog of ₩10.72T (+63%) at Q2 2025 (https://www.asiae.co.kr/en/article/2025072809270788265).

hindsight.name: Hanmi Semiconductor

research.preconditions: Revenue was falling at the start: 2023 sales about ₩159B and operating profit ₩34.5B (KED, July 2024) vs ₩327.6B 2022 sales. Orders and the bottleneck position led reported revenue. Later risk: second-sourcing to Hanwha Precision Machinery (2024), and Q1 2026 sales ₩50.9B (-65.5%), operating profit -87.9% (reported).
research.catalysts: Sole TC-bonder supplier for SK hynix HBM. The ₩41.5B 'Dual TC Bonder 1.0 Dragon' order (Sept 2023) was its largest ever, equal to 12.69% of 2022 revenue. Cumulative SK hynix orders reached ₩358.7B by June 2024 (https://amp.kedglobal.com/newsAmp/ked202406070008).

hindsight.name: Alteogen

research.preconditions: Platform-technology biotech, operating-loss-making in 2023 and dependent on milestones. Validation by a big-pharma partner on the world's top-selling drug was the key re-rating trigger. Basis: reported (Asia Business Daily).
research.catalysts: On 2024-02-22 the Merck (MSD) license was amended to make ALT-B4 hyaluronidase exclusive for Keytruda SC: up to ₩575B, $20M upfront. Keytruda SC FDA approval in Sept 2025; royalties reportedly about 2% of net sales.

hindsight.name: Rainbow Robotics

research.preconditions: Tiny revenue, roughly breakeven (2022 operating profit about ₩1.3B, aggregator). Humanoid and cobot platform. A strategic-acquirer option premium drove the run, not earnings. Basis: reported (KED Global).
research.catalysts: Samsung Electronics took a 10.22% stake via third-party allotment at ₩30,400 (Jan 2023), raised it to 14.99% (Mar 2023) with call options up to 59.94%, then exercised to 35% in Dec 2024 and consolidated it as a subsidiary. Price went from ₩34,450 at end-2022 to ₩120,700 by mid-March 2023. Surpassed ₩350,000 in Feb 2025 (https://www.asiae.co.kr/en/article/2025020509212617245).

hindsight.name: Hanwha Aerospace

research.preconditions: Profitable industrial conglomerate at a low multiple before export orders. The order-backlog step change came from geopolitics. Q3 2026 operating profit -46% YoY (reported) shows the cycle risk. Basis: reported (Asia Business Daily).
research.catalysts: Post-Ukraine European rearmament. The 2022 Poland framework deals (K9 howitzers and Chunmoo) became export deliveries. 2023 operating profit ₩704.9B (+76%). Intraday peak ₩1,127,000 in 2025 (https://www.asiae.co.kr/en/article/2025101409580700456). Also has space and launch exposure.

method.hit: 시작 종가의 10배 이상 월말 종가가 60개월 안에 나옴
method.halved: 36개월 안에 시작 종가의 절반 이하 월말 종가
method.startSize: 오늘 시가총액 × (시작 종가 ÷ 최근 종가) — 주식 수 변화 무시한 근사
method.offHigh: 시작 시점 직전 12개월 월말 종가 최고치 대비
method.noData: 시작 시점의 매출 성장률·FCF는 과거 재무를 수집하지 않아 없음
method.bias: 현재 상장 종목만 포함 — 상장폐지 실패 사례가 빠진 생존 편향
